+class SessionEvent:
+    kind: TriggerKind | str
+    session_id: str
+    due_at: datetime
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        try:
+            kind = self.kind if isinstance(self.kind, TriggerKind) else TriggerKind(str(self.kind))
+        except ValueError:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown session trigger kind {self.kind!r}") from None
+        if kind not in _SESSION_KINDS:
+            raise ValueError(f"{kind.value} is not a session trigger")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "kind", kind)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "session_id", _identifier(self.session_id, "session_id"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "due_at", _utc(self.due_at, "due_at"))
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ControlTick:
+    """Request a cadence check using the scheduler's injected clock."""
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ManualEvaluationRequest:
+    symbol: str
+    strategy_id: str
+    side: StrategyRole | str
+    request_id: str | None = None
+    due_at: datetime | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", _symbol(self.symbol))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "strategy_id", _identifier(self.strategy_id, "strategy_id"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "side", _side(self.side))
+        if self.request_id is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "request_id", _identifier(self.request_id, "request_id"))
+        if self.due_at is not None:
+            object.__setattr__(self, "due_at", _utc(self.due_at, "due_at"))
+
+
+type SchedulingEvent = (
+    MarketDataArrivalEvent
+    | QuoteChangeEvent
+    | CandleClosedEvent
+    | SessionEvent
+    | ControlTick
+    | ManualEvaluationRequest
+)
+
+
+class _DefaultCalendar:
+    def session_for(self, day: date) -> Session:
+        return exchange_calendar.session_for(day)
+
+    def entry_cutoff(self, session: Session, minutes_before_close: int) -> datetime:
+        return exchange_calendar.entry_cutoff(session, minutes_before_close)
+
+
+_PRIORITY = {
+    TriggerKind.SESSION_OPEN: 0,
+    TriggerKind.ENTRY_CUTOFF: 0,
+    TriggerKind.SESSION_CLOSE: 0,
+    TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED: 1,
+    TriggerKind.QUOTE_CHANGE: 2,
+    TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL: 2,
+    TriggerKind.INTERVAL: 3,
+    TriggerKind.MANUAL: 4,
+}
+
+_RegistryKey = tuple[str, str, StrategyRole]
+_SeenKey = tuple[_RegistryKey, TriggerKind, object]
+
+
+class StrategyScheduler:
+    """One deterministic scheduler shared by every symbol and strategy.
+
+    The synchronous :meth:`process` API is useful to an engine event loop that
+    already serializes inputs.  :meth:`handle` provides an asyncio-safe entry
+    point using one scheduler-level lock; neither API creates background tasks.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        clock: ClockLike,
+        *,
+        calendar: CalendarLike | None = None,
+        watched_symbols: Iterable[str] = (),
+        entry_cutoff_minutes: int = 30,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not hasattr(clock, "now"):
+            raise TypeError("clock must provide now()")
+        if (
+            isinstance(entry_cutoff_minutes, bool)
+            or not isinstance(entry_cutoff_minutes, int)
+            or entry_cutoff_minutes < 0
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("entry_cutoff_minutes must be a non-negative integer")
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._calendar: CalendarLike = calendar or _DefaultCalendar()
+        self._entry_cutoff_minutes = entry_cutoff_minutes
+        self._watched = {_symbol(symbol) for symbol in watched_symbols}
+        self._registry: dict[_RegistryKey, StrategySchedule] = {}
+        self._registered_at: dict[_RegistryKey, datetime] = {}
+        self._next_interval: dict[tuple[_RegistryKey, StrategyTrigger], datetime] = {}
+        self._latest_snapshot: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self._quotes: dict[str, tuple[Decimal, Decimal]] = {}
+        self._seen: set[_SeenKey] = set()
+        self._last_control_at = self._now()
+        self._manual_sequence = 0
+        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
+
+    def _now(self) -> datetime:
+        return _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock.now()")
+
+    @property
+    def watched_symbols(self) -> frozenset[str]:
+        return frozenset(self._watched)
+
+    @property
+    def registrations(self) -> tuple[StrategySchedule, ...]:
+        return tuple(sorted(self._registry.values(), key=self._registration_sort_key))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _registration_sort_key(item: StrategySchedule) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
+        return item.symbol, item.strategy_id, item.side.value
+
+    def watch(self, symbol: str) -> None:
+        self._watched.add(_symbol(symbol))
+
+    watch_symbol = watch
+
+    def unwatch(self, symbol: str) -> None:
+        self._watched.discard(_symbol(symbol))
+
+    unwatch_symbol = unwatch
+
+    def register(
+        self,
+        schedule: StrategySchedule | None = None,
+        *,
+        symbol: str | None = None,
+        strategy_id: str | None = None,
+        side: StrategyRole | str | None = None,
+        triggers: Iterable[StrategyTrigger] | None = None,
+        enabled: bool = True,
+        paused: bool = False,
+    ) -> StrategySchedule:
+        if schedule is None:
+            if symbol is None or strategy_id is None or side is None or triggers is None:
+                raise TypeError("register requires a schedule or symbol/strategy_id/side/triggers")
+            schedule = StrategySchedule(
+                symbol=symbol,
+                strategy_id=strategy_id,
+                side=_side(side),
+                triggers=triggers,
+                enabled=enabled,
+                paused=paused,
+            )
+        elif any(value is not None for value in (symbol, strategy_id, side, triggers)):
+            raise TypeError("schedule cannot be combined with registration fields")
+        elif not isinstance(schedule, StrategySchedule):
+            raise TypeError("schedule must be StrategySchedule")
+
+        key = (schedule.symbol, schedule.strategy_id, schedule.side)
+        now = self._now()
+        self._registry[key] = schedule
+        self._registered_at[key] = now
+        for interval_key in tuple(self._next_interval):
+            if interval_key[0] == key:
+                del self._next_interval[interval_key]
+        for trigger in schedule.triggers:
+            if trigger.kind is TriggerKind.INTERVAL:
+                self._next_interval[(key, trigger)] = now + timedelta(
+                    seconds=trigger.interval_seconds  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                )
+        return schedule
+
+    register_strategy = register
+
+    def unregister(self, symbol: str, strategy_id: str, side: StrategyRole | str) -> None:
+        key = (_symbol(symbol), _identifier(strategy_id, "strategy_id"), _side(side))
+        self._registry.pop(key, None)
+        self._registered_at.pop(key, None)
+        for interval_key in tuple(self._next_interval):
+            if interval_key[0] == key:
+                del self._next_interval[interval_key]
+
+    def set_state(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        strategy_id: str,
+        side: StrategyRole | str,
+        *,
+        enabled: bool | None = None,
+        paused: bool | None = None,
+    ) -> StrategySchedule:
+        key = (_symbol(symbol), _identifier(strategy_id, "strategy_id"), _side(side))
+        current = self._registry[key]
+        if enabled is not None and not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+            raise ValueError("enabled must be bool")
+        if paused is not None and not isinstance(paused, bool):
+            raise ValueError("paused must be bool")
+        updated = replace(
+            current,
+            enabled=current.enabled if enabled is None else enabled,
+            paused=current.paused if paused is None else paused,
+        )
+        self._registry[key] = updated
+        return updated
+
+    def process(self, event: SchedulingEvent) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        """Process one input and return a deterministically ordered due list."""
+
+        return self.process_many((event,))
+
+    def on_market_data_arrival(
+        self, symbol: str, snapshot_version: int, due_at: datetime | None = None
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(MarketDataArrivalEvent(symbol, snapshot_version, due_at))
+
+    def on_quote_change(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        bid: Decimal | int | float | str,
+        ask: Decimal | int | float | str,
+        snapshot_version: int,
+        due_at: datetime | None = None,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(QuoteChangeEvent(symbol, bid, ask, snapshot_version, due_at))
+
+    def on_candle_closed(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        timeframe: CandleTimeframe | str,
+        bar_end_utc: datetime,
+        snapshot_version: int | None = None,
+        due_at: datetime | None = None,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(
+            CandleClosedEvent(
+                symbol, timeframe, bar_end_utc, snapshot_version, due_at
+            )
+        )
+
+    def on_session_event(
+        self,
+        kind: TriggerKind | str,
+        session_id: str,
+        due_at: datetime,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(SessionEvent(kind, session_id, due_at))
+
+    def on_control_tick(self) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(ControlTick())
+
+    def request_manual(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        strategy_id: str,
+        side: StrategyRole | str,
+        *,
+        request_id: str | None = None,
+        due_at: datetime | None = None,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(
+            ManualEvaluationRequest(symbol, strategy_id, side, request_id, due_at)
+        )
+
+    def process_many(self, events: Iterable[SchedulingEvent]) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        """Process inputs in their given order, then order all resulting records."""
+
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        for event in events:
+            due.extend(self._process_one(event))
+        due.sort(key=self.sort_key)
+        return due
+
+    async def handle(self, event: SchedulingEvent) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        """Asyncio-safe event entry point using one component-wide lock."""
+
+        async with self._lock:
+            return self.process(event)
+
+    async def handle_many(self, events: Iterable[SchedulingEvent]) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        async with self._lock:
+            return self.process_many(events)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def sort_key(item: DueEvaluation) -> tuple[datetime, int, str, str, str]:
+        return (
+            item.due_at,
+            _PRIORITY[item.trigger_kind],
+            item.symbol,
+            item.strategy_id,
+            item.side.value,
+        )
+
+    def _process_one(self, event: SchedulingEvent) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        if isinstance(event, MarketDataArrivalEvent):
+            self._latest_snapshot[event.symbol] = event.snapshot_version
+            return self._emit_for_kind(
+                event.symbol,
+                TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL,
+                event.due_at or self._now(),
+                snapshot_version=event.snapshot_version,
+                discriminator=event.snapshot_version,
+            )
+        if isinstance(event, QuoteChangeEvent):
+            self._latest_snapshot[event.symbol] = event.snapshot_version
+            quote = (cast(Decimal, event.bid), cast(Decimal, event.ask))
+            previous = self._quotes.get(event.symbol)
+            self._quotes[event.symbol] = quote
+            if quote == previous:
+                return []
+            return self._emit_for_kind(
+                event.symbol,
+                TriggerKind.QUOTE_CHANGE,
+                event.due_at or self._now(),
+                snapshot_version=event.snapshot_version,
+                discriminator=event.snapshot_version,
+            )
+        if isinstance(event, CandleClosedEvent):
+            if event.snapshot_version is not None:
+                self._latest_snapshot[event.symbol] = event.snapshot_version
+            bar_key = BarKey(event.symbol, event.timeframe, event.bar_end_utc)
+            return self._emit_for_kind(
+                event.symbol,
+                TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED,
+                event.due_at or event.bar_end_utc,
+                snapshot_version=event.snapshot_version
+                if event.snapshot_version is not None
+                else self._latest_snapshot.get(event.symbol),
+                bar_key=bar_key,
+                discriminator=bar_key,
+                timeframe=cast(CandleTimeframe, event.timeframe),
+            )
+        if isinstance(event, SessionEvent):
+            return self._emit_all_symbols(
+                cast(TriggerKind, event.kind),
+                event.due_at,
+                discriminator=event.session_id,
+            )
+        if isinstance(event, ControlTick):
+            return self._control_tick()
+        if isinstance(event, ManualEvaluationRequest):
+            return self._manual(event)
+        raise TypeError(f"unsupported scheduling event {type(event).__name__}")
+
+    def _eligible(self, schedule: StrategySchedule) -> bool:
+        return (
+            schedule.symbol in self._watched and schedule.enabled and not schedule.paused
+        )
+
+    def _emit_for_kind(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        kind: TriggerKind,
+        due_at: datetime,
+        *,
+        discriminator: object,
+        snapshot_version: int | None = None,
+        bar_key: BarKey | None = None,
+        timeframe: CandleTimeframe | None = None,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        for key, schedule in sorted(
+            self._registry.items(), key=lambda item: self._registration_sort_key(item[1])
+        ):
+            if schedule.symbol != symbol or not self._eligible(schedule):
+                continue
+            matching = [trigger for trigger in schedule.triggers if trigger.kind is kind]
+            if timeframe is not None:
+                matching = [trigger for trigger in matching if trigger.timeframe is timeframe]
+            if not matching:
+                continue
+            seen_key = (key, kind, discriminator)
+            if seen_key in self._seen:
+                continue
+            self._seen.add(seen_key)
+            due.append(
+                DueEvaluation(
+                    symbol=schedule.symbol,
+                    strategy_id=schedule.strategy_id,
+                    side=schedule.side,
+                    trigger_kind=kind,
+                    snapshot_version=snapshot_version,
+                    bar_key=bar_key,
+                    due_at=due_at,
+                )
+            )
+        return due
+
+    def _emit_all_symbols(
+        self, kind: TriggerKind, due_at: datetime, *, discriminator: object
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        for symbol in sorted(self._watched):
+            due.extend(
+                self._emit_for_kind(
+                    symbol,
+                    kind,
+                    due_at,
+                    discriminator=discriminator,
+                    snapshot_version=self._latest_snapshot.get(symbol),
+                )
+            )
+        return due
+
+    def _manual(self, event: ManualEvaluationRequest) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        key = (event.symbol, event.strategy_id, cast(StrategyRole, event.side))
+        schedule = self._registry.get(key)
+        if (
+            schedule is None
+            or not self._eligible(schedule)
+            or all(trigger.kind is not TriggerKind.MANUAL for trigger in schedule.triggers)
+        ):
+            return []
+        self._manual_sequence += 1
+        discriminator: object = event.request_id or self._manual_sequence
+        seen_key = (key, TriggerKind.MANUAL, discriminator)
+        if seen_key in self._seen:
+            return []
+        self._seen.add(seen_key)
+        return [
+            DueEvaluation(
+                symbol=schedule.symbol,
+                strategy_id=schedule.strategy_id,
+                side=schedule.side,
+                trigger_kind=TriggerKind.MANUAL,
+                snapshot_version=self._latest_snapshot.get(schedule.symbol),
+                bar_key=None,
+                due_at=event.due_at or self._now(),
+            )
+        ]
+
+    def _control_tick(self) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        now = self._now()
+        if now < self._last_control_at:
+            raise ValueError("clock moved backwards")
+        due = self._session_boundaries(self._last_control_at, now)
+        due.extend(self._intervals(now))
+        self._last_control_at = now
+        return due
+
+    def _intervals(self, now: datetime) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        for (key, trigger), next_due in sorted(
+            self._next_interval.items(),
+            key=lambda item: (
+                item[1],
+                item[0][0][0],
+                item[0][0][1],
+                item[0][0][2].value,
+                item[0][1].interval_seconds or 0,
+            ),
+        ):
+            schedule = self._registry.get(key)
+            if schedule is None or now < next_due:
+                continue
+            seconds = trigger.interval_seconds
+            assert seconds is not None
+            interval = timedelta(seconds=seconds)
+            elapsed = (now - next_due) // interval
+            self._next_interval[(key, trigger)] = next_due + interval * (elapsed + 1)
+            if not self._eligible(schedule):
+                continue
+            discriminator = next_due
+            seen_key = (key, TriggerKind.INTERVAL, discriminator)
+            if seen_key in self._seen:
+                continue
+            self._seen.add(seen_key)
+            due.append(
+                DueEvaluation(
+                    symbol=schedule.symbol,
+                    strategy_id=schedule.strategy_id,
+                    side=schedule.side,
+                    trigger_kind=TriggerKind.INTERVAL,
+                    snapshot_version=self._latest_snapshot.get(schedule.symbol),
+                    bar_key=None,
+                    due_at=next_due,
+                )
+            )
+        return due
+
+    def _session_boundaries(self, start: datetime, end: datetime) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        if end == start:
+            return []
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        local_start = start.astimezone(exchange_calendar.NEW_YORK).date()
+        local_end = end.astimezone(exchange_calendar.NEW_YORK).date()
+        day = local_start
+        while day <= local_end:
+            try:
+                session = self._calendar.session_for(day)
+            except ValueError:
+                day += timedelta(days=1)
+                continue
+            cutoff = _utc(
+                self._calendar.entry_cutoff(session, self._entry_cutoff_minutes),
+                "entry cutoff",
+            )
+            boundaries = (
+                (TriggerKind.SESSION_OPEN, _utc(session.open_utc, "session open")),
+                (TriggerKind.ENTRY_CUTOFF, cutoff),
+                (TriggerKind.SESSION_CLOSE, _utc(session.close_utc, "session close")),
+            )
+            for kind, instant in boundaries:
+                if start < instant <= end:
+                    due.extend(
+                        self._emit_all_symbols(
+                            kind, instant, discriminator=session.session_id
+                        )
+                    )
+            day += timedelta(days=1)
+        return due
+
+
+# Alternate descriptive name for callers that do not use the Strategy prefix.
+Scheduler = StrategyScheduler
+DueScheduler = StrategyScheduler

+"""Declarative, immutable strategy scheduling triggers.
+
+The declarations in this module contain configuration only.  They deliberately
+have no references to strategies, market-data providers, or execution services.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from enum import StrEnum
+from math import isfinite
+from typing import Final
+
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import ConfigurationError
+from mike_trade.market_data.candles import CandleTimeframe
+
+__all__ = [
+    "TriggerConfigurationError",
+    "TriggerKind",
+    "StrategyTrigger",
+    "Trigger",
+    "MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL",
+    "QUOTE_CHANGE",
+    "SESSION_OPEN",
+    "ENTRY_CUTOFF",
+    "SESSION_CLOSE",
+    "MANUAL",
+    "CANDLE_CLOSED",
+    "INTERVAL",
+]
+
+
+class TriggerConfigurationError(ConfigurationError, ValueError):
+    """Raised when a declarative trigger cannot be loaded safely."""
+
+
+class TriggerKind(StrEnum):
+    """The complete set of scheduler trigger kinds."""
+
+    MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL = "MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL"
+    QUOTE_CHANGE = "QUOTE_CHANGE"
+    CANDLE_CLOSED = "CANDLE_CLOSED"
+    INTERVAL = "INTERVAL"
+    SESSION_OPEN = "SESSION_OPEN"
+    ENTRY_CUTOFF = "ENTRY_CUTOFF"
+    SESSION_CLOSE = "SESSION_CLOSE"
+    MANUAL = "MANUAL"
+
+
+def _error(message: str) -> TriggerConfigurationError:
+    return TriggerConfigurationError(message, code="invalid_strategy_trigger")
+
+
+def _kind(value: object) -> TriggerKind:
+    if isinstance(value, TriggerKind):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return TriggerKind(value.strip().upper())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    raise _error(f"unknown trigger kind {value!r}")
+
+
+def _timeframe(value: object) -> CandleTimeframe:
+    if isinstance(value, CandleTimeframe):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return CandleTimeframe(value.strip().lower())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    supported = ", ".join(frame.value for frame in CandleTimeframe)
+    raise _error(f"unsupported candle timeframe {value!r}; expected one of {supported}")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class StrategyTrigger:
+    """One validated trigger attached to a BUY or SELL strategy declaration.
+
+    ``timeframe`` is present only for :attr:`TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED`, and
+    ``interval_seconds`` only for :attr:`TriggerKind.INTERVAL`.
+    """
+
+    kind: TriggerKind | str
+    timeframe: CandleTimeframe | str | None = None
+    interval_seconds: float | int | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        kind = _kind(self.kind)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "kind", kind)
+
+        if kind is TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED:
+            if self.timeframe is None:
+                raise _error("CANDLE_CLOSED requires a supported timeframe")
+            object.__setattr__(self, "timeframe", _timeframe(self.timeframe))
+        elif self.timeframe is not None:
+            raise _error(f"{kind.value} must not specify a timeframe")
+
+        if kind is TriggerKind.INTERVAL:
+            seconds = self.interval_seconds
+            if (
+                isinstance(seconds, bool)
+                or not isinstance(seconds, int | float)
+                or not isfinite(seconds)
+                or seconds <= 0
+            ):
+                raise _error("INTERVAL requires positive finite interval_seconds")
+            object.__setattr__(self, "interval_seconds", float(seconds))
+        elif self.interval_seconds is not None:
+            raise _error(f"{kind.value} must not specify interval_seconds")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def candle_closed(cls, timeframe: CandleTimeframe | str) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED, timeframe=timeframe)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def interval(cls, seconds: float | int) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.INTERVAL, interval_seconds=seconds)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def market_data_arrival(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def quote_change(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.QUOTE_CHANGE)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def session_open(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.SESSION_OPEN)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def entry_cutoff(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.ENTRY_CUTOFF)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def session_close(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.SESSION_CLOSE)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def manual(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.MANUAL)
+
+
+# A short alias is convenient in strategy class configuration.
+Trigger = StrategyTrigger
+
+# Parameter-free declarations are safe to share because they are frozen values.
+MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL)
+QUOTE_CHANGE: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.QUOTE_CHANGE)
+SESSION_OPEN: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.SESSION_OPEN)
+ENTRY_CUTOFF: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.ENTRY_CUTOFF)
+SESSION_CLOSE: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.SESSION_CLOSE)

+"""Deterministic, engine-owned strategy due scheduler.

+tasks, and performs no strategy, broker, provider, or order work.
+"""

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+from collections.abc import Iterable

+from mike_trade.scheduling.triggers import StrategyTrigger, TriggerKind

+__all__ = [
+    "BarKey",
+    "DueEvaluation",
+    "StrategySchedule",
+    "MarketDataArrivalEvent",
+    "QuoteChangeEvent",
+    "CandleClosedEvent",
+    "SessionEvent",
+    "ControlTick",
+    "ManualEvaluationRequest",
+    "SchedulingEvent",

+    "DueScheduler",
+]

+    def now(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+
+class CalendarLike(Protocol):
+    def session_for(self, day: date) -> Session: ...
+
+    def entry_cutoff(self, session: Session, minutes_before_close: int) -> datetime: ...
+
+
+def _utc(value: object, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)
+
+
+def _symbol(value: object) -> str:
+    text = value.strip().upper() if isinstance(value, str) else ""
+    if not text or any(character.isspace() for character in text):
+        raise ValueError("symbol must be a non-empty string without whitespace")
+    return text
+
+
+def _identifier(value: object, field: str) -> str:
+    text = value.strip() if isinstance(value, str) else ""
+    if not text:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return text
+
+
+def _side(value: object) -> StrategyRole:
+    if isinstance(value, StrategyRole):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return StrategyRole(value.strip().upper())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    raise ValueError("side must be StrategyRole.BUY or StrategyRole.SELL")
+
+
+def _version(value: object) -> int:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 1:
+        raise ValueError("snapshot_version must be a positive integer")
+    return value
+
+
+def _timeframe(value: object) -> CandleTimeframe:
+    if isinstance(value, CandleTimeframe):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return CandleTimeframe(value.strip().lower())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    raise ValueError(f"unsupported candle timeframe {value!r}")
+
+
+def _price(value: object, field: str) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be numeric")
+    try:
+        result = Decimal(str(value))
+    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be numeric") from None
+    if not result.is_finite() or result < 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite and non-negative")

+_PRIORITY = {
+    TriggerKind.SESSION_OPEN: 0,
+    TriggerKind.ENTRY_CUTOFF: 0,
+    TriggerKind.SESSION_CLOSE: 0,
+    TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED: 1,
+    TriggerKind.QUOTE_CHANGE: 2,
+    TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL: 2,
+    TriggerKind.INTERVAL: 3,
+    TriggerKind.MANUAL: 4,
+}
+
+_RegistryKey = tuple[str, str, StrategyRole]
+_SeenKey = tuple[_RegistryKey, TriggerKind, object]
+
+
+class StrategyScheduler:
+    """One deterministic scheduler shared by every symbol and strategy.
+
+    The synchronous :meth:`process` API is useful to an engine event loop that
+    already serializes inputs.  :meth:`handle` provides an asyncio-safe entry
+    point using one scheduler-level lock; neither API creates background tasks.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        clock: ClockLike,
+        *,
+        calendar: CalendarLike | None = None,
+        watched_symbols: Iterable[str] = (),
+        entry_cutoff_minutes: int = 30,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not hasattr(clock, "now"):
+            raise TypeError("clock must provide now()")
+        if (
+            isinstance(entry_cutoff_minutes, bool)
+            or not isinstance(entry_cutoff_minutes, int)
+            or entry_cutoff_minutes < 0
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("entry_cutoff_minutes must be a non-negative integer")
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._calendar: CalendarLike = calendar or _DefaultCalendar()
+        self._entry_cutoff_minutes = entry_cutoff_minutes
+        self._watched = {_symbol(symbol) for symbol in watched_symbols}
+        self._registry: dict[_RegistryKey, StrategySchedule] = {}
+        self._registered_at: dict[_RegistryKey, datetime] = {}
+        self._next_interval: dict[tuple[_RegistryKey, StrategyTrigger], datetime] = {}
+        self._latest_snapshot: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self._quotes: dict[str, tuple[Decimal, Decimal]] = {}
+        self._seen: set[_SeenKey] = set()
+        self._last_control_at = self._now()
+        self._manual_sequence = 0
+        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
+
+    def _now(self) -> datetime:
+        return _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock.now()")
+
+    @property
+    def watched_symbols(self) -> frozenset[str]:
+        return frozenset(self._watched)
+
+    @property
+    def registrations(self) -> tuple[StrategySchedule, ...]:
+        return tuple(sorted(self._registry.values(), key=self._registration_sort_key))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _registration_sort_key(item: StrategySchedule) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
+        return item.symbol, item.strategy_id, item.side.value
+
+    def watch(self, symbol: str) -> None:
+        self._watched.add(_symbol(symbol))
+
+    watch_symbol = watch
+
+    def unwatch(self, symbol: str) -> None:
+        self._watched.discard(_symbol(symbol))
+
+    unwatch_symbol = unwatch
+
+    def register(
+        self,
+        schedule: StrategySchedule | None = None,
+        *,
+        symbol: str | None = None,
+        strategy_id: str | None = None,
+        side: StrategyRole | str | None = None,
+        triggers: Iterable[StrategyTrigger] | None = None,
+        enabled: bool = True,
+        paused: bool = False,
+    ) -> StrategySchedule:
+        if schedule is None:
+            if symbol is None or strategy_id is None or side is None or triggers is None:
+                raise TypeError("register requires a schedule or symbol/strategy_id/side/triggers")
+            schedule = StrategySchedule(
+                symbol=symbol,
+                strategy_id=strategy_id,
+                side=_side(side),
+                triggers=triggers,
+                enabled=enabled,
+                paused=paused,
+            )
+        elif any(value is not None for value in (symbol, strategy_id, side, triggers)):
+            raise TypeError("schedule cannot be combined with registration fields")
+        elif not isinstance(schedule, StrategySchedule):
+            raise TypeError("schedule must be StrategySchedule")
+
+        key = (schedule.symbol, schedule.strategy_id, schedule.side)
+        now = self._now()
+        self._registry[key] = schedule
+        self._registered_at[key] = now
+        for interval_key in tuple(self._next_interval):
+            if interval_key[0] == key:
+                del self._next_interval[interval_key]
+        for trigger in schedule.triggers:
+            if trigger.kind is TriggerKind.INTERVAL:
+                self._next_interval[(key, trigger)] = now + timedelta(
+                    seconds=trigger.interval_seconds  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                )
+        return schedule
+
+    register_strategy = register
+
+    def unregister(self, symbol: str, strategy_id: str, side: StrategyRole | str) -> None:
+        key = (_symbol(symbol), _identifier(strategy_id, "strategy_id"), _side(side))
+        self._registry.pop(key, None)
+        self._registered_at.pop(key, None)
+        for interval_key in tuple(self._next_interval):
+            if interval_key[0] == key:
+                del self._next_interval[interval_key]
+
+    def set_state(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        strategy_id: str,
+        side: StrategyRole | str,
+        *,
+        enabled: bool | None = None,
+        paused: bool | None = None,
+    ) -> StrategySchedule:
+        key = (_symbol(symbol), _identifier(strategy_id, "strategy_id"), _side(side))
+        current = self._registry[key]
+        if enabled is not None and not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+            raise ValueError("enabled must be bool")
+        if paused is not None and not isinstance(paused, bool):
+            raise ValueError("paused must be bool")
+        updated = replace(
+            current,
+            enabled=current.enabled if enabled is None else enabled,
+            paused=current.paused if paused is None else paused,
+        )
+        self._registry[key] = updated
+        return updated
+
+    def process(self, event: SchedulingEvent) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        """Process one input and return a deterministically ordered due list."""
+
+        return self.process_many((event,))
+
+    def on_market_data_arrival(
+        self, symbol: str, snapshot_version: int, due_at: datetime | None = None
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(MarketDataArrivalEvent(symbol, snapshot_version, due_at))
+
+    def on_quote_change(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        bid: Decimal | int | float | str,
+        ask: Decimal | int | float | str,
+        snapshot_version: int,
+        due_at: datetime | None = None,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(QuoteChangeEvent(symbol, bid, ask, snapshot_version, due_at))
+
+    def on_candle_closed(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        timeframe: CandleTimeframe | str,
+        bar_end_utc: datetime,
+        snapshot_version: int | None = None,
+        due_at: datetime | None = None,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(
+            CandleClosedEvent(
+                symbol, timeframe, bar_end_utc, snapshot_version, due_at
+            )
+        )
+
+    def on_session_event(
+        self,
+        kind: TriggerKind | str,
+        session_id: str,
+        due_at: datetime,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(SessionEvent(kind, session_id, due_at))
+
+    def on_control_tick(self) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(ControlTick())
+
+    def request_manual(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        strategy_id: str,
+        side: StrategyRole | str,
+        *,
+        request_id: str | None = None,
+        due_at: datetime | None = None,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(
+            ManualEvaluationRequest(symbol, strategy_id, side, request_id, due_at)
+        )
+
+    def process_many(self, events: Iterable[SchedulingEvent]) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        """Process inputs in their given order, then order all resulting records."""
+
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        for event in events:
+            due.extend(self._process_one(event))
+        due.sort(key=self.sort_key)
+        return due
+
+    async def handle(self, event: SchedulingEvent) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        """Asyncio-safe event entry point using one component-wide lock."""
+
+        async with self._lock:
+            return self.process(event)
+
+    async def handle_many(self, events: Iterable[SchedulingEvent]) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        async with self._lock:
+            return self.process_many(events)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def sort_key(item: DueEvaluation) -> tuple[datetime, int, str, str, str]:
+        return (
+            item.due_at,
+            _PRIORITY[item.trigger_kind],
+            item.symbol,
+            item.strategy_id,
+            item.side.value,
+        )
+
+    def _process_one(self, event: SchedulingEvent) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        if isinstance(event, MarketDataArrivalEvent):
+            self._latest_snapshot[event.symbol] = event.snapshot_version
+            return self._emit_for_kind(
+                event.symbol,
+                TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL,
+                event.due_at or self._now(),
+                snapshot_version=event.snapshot_version,
+                discriminator=event.snapshot_version,
+            )
+        if isinstance(event, QuoteChangeEvent):
+            self._latest_snapshot[event.symbol] = event.snapshot_version
+            quote = (cast(Decimal, event.bid), cast(Decimal, event.ask))
+            previous = self._quotes.get(event.symbol)
+            self._quotes[event.symbol] = quote
+            if quote == previous:
+                return []
+            return self._emit_for_kind(
+                event.symbol,
+                TriggerKind.QUOTE_CHANGE,
+                event.due_at or self._now(),
+                snapshot_version=event.snapshot_version,
+                discriminator=event.snapshot_version,
+            )
+        if isinstance(event, CandleClosedEvent):
+            if event.snapshot_version is not None:
+                self._latest_snapshot[event.symbol] = event.snapshot_version
+            bar_key = BarKey(event.symbol, event.timeframe, event.bar_end_utc)
+            return self._emit_for_kind(
+                event.symbol,
+                TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED,
+                event.due_at or event.bar_end_utc,
+                snapshot_version=event.snapshot_version
+                if event.snapshot_version is not None
+                else self._latest_snapshot.get(event.symbol),
+                bar_key=bar_key,
+                discriminator=bar_key,
+                timeframe=cast(CandleTimeframe, event.timeframe),
+            )
+        if isinstance(event, SessionEvent):
+            return self._emit_all_symbols(
+                cast(TriggerKind, event.kind),
+                event.due_at,
+                discriminator=event.session_id,
+            )
+        if isinstance(event, ControlTick):
+            return self._control_tick()
+        if isinstance(event, ManualEvaluationRequest):
+            return self._manual(event)
+        raise TypeError(f"unsupported scheduling event {type(event).__name__}")
+
+    def _eligible(self, schedule: StrategySchedule) -> bool:
+        return (
+            schedule.symbol in self._watched and schedule.enabled and not schedule.paused
+        )
+
+    def _emit_for_kind(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        kind: TriggerKind,
+        due_at: datetime,
+        *,
+        discriminator: object,
+        snapshot_version: int | None = None,
+        bar_key: BarKey | None = None,
+        timeframe: CandleTimeframe | None = None,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        for key, schedule in sorted(
+            self._registry.items(), key=lambda item: self._registration_sort_key(item[1])
+        ):
+            if schedule.symbol != symbol or not self._eligible(schedule):
+                continue
+            matching = [trigger for trigger in schedule.triggers if trigger.kind is kind]
+            if timeframe is not None:
+                matching = [trigger for trigger in matching if trigger.timeframe is timeframe]
+            if not matching:
+                continue
+            seen_key = (key, kind, discriminator)
+            if seen_key in self._seen:
+                continue
+            self._seen.add(seen_key)
+            due.append(
+                DueEvaluation(
+                    symbol=schedule.symbol,
+                    strategy_id=schedule.strategy_id,
+                    side=schedule.side,
+                    trigger_kind=kind,
+                    snapshot_version=snapshot_version,
+                    bar_key=bar_key,
+                    due_at=due_at,
+                )
+            )
+        return due
+
+    def _emit_all_symbols(
+        self, kind: TriggerKind, due_at: datetime, *, discriminator: object
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        for symbol in sorted(self._watched):
+            due.extend(
+                self._emit_for_kind(
+                    symbol,
+                    kind,
+                    due_at,
+                    discriminator=discriminator,
+                    snapshot_version=self._latest_snapshot.get(symbol),
+                )
+            )
+        return due
+
+    def _manual(self, event: ManualEvaluationRequest) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        key = (event.symbol, event.strategy_id, cast(StrategyRole, event.side))
+        schedule = self._registry.get(key)
+        if (
+            schedule is None
+            or not self._eligible(schedule)
+            or all(trigger.kind is not TriggerKind.MANUAL for trigger in schedule.triggers)
+        ):
+            return []
+        self._manual_sequence += 1
+        discriminator: object = event.request_id or self._manual_sequence
+        seen_key = (key, TriggerKind.MANUAL, discriminator)
+        if seen_key in self._seen:
+            return []
+        self._seen.add(seen_key)
+        return [
+            DueEvaluation(
+                symbol=schedule.symbol,
+                strategy_id=schedule.strategy_id,
+                side=schedule.side,
+                trigger_kind=TriggerKind.MANUAL,
+                snapshot_version=self._latest_snapshot.get(schedule.symbol),
+                bar_key=None,
+                due_at=event.due_at or self._now(),
+            )
+        ]
+
+    def _control_tick(self) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        now = self._now()
+        if now < self._last_control_at:
+            raise ValueError("clock moved backwards")
+        due = self._session_boundaries(self._last_control_at, now)
+        due.extend(self._intervals(now))
+        self._last_control_at = now
+        return due
+
+    def _intervals(self, now: datetime) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        for (key, trigger), next_due in sorted(
+            self._next_interval.items(),
+            key=lambda item: (
+                item[1],
+                item[0][0][0],
+                item[0][0][1],
+                item[0][0][2].value,
+                item[0][1].interval_seconds or 0,
+            ),
+        ):
+            schedule = self._registry.get(key)
+            if schedule is None or now < next_due:
+                continue
+            seconds = trigger.interval_seconds
+            assert seconds is not None
+            interval = timedelta(seconds=seconds)
+            elapsed = (now - next_due) // interval
+            self._next_interval[(key, trigger)] = next_due + interval * (elapsed + 1)
+            if not self._eligible(schedule):
+                continue
+            discriminator = next_due
+            seen_key = (key, TriggerKind.INTERVAL, discriminator)
+            if seen_key in self._seen:
+                continue
+            self._seen.add(seen_key)
+            due.append(
+                DueEvaluation(
+                    symbol=schedule.symbol,
+                    strategy_id=schedule.strategy_id,
+                    side=schedule.side,
+                    trigger_kind=TriggerKind.INTERVAL,
+                    snapshot_version=self._latest_snapshot.get(schedule.symbol),
+                    bar_key=None,
+                    due_at=next_due,
+                )
+            )
+        return due
+
+    def _session_boundaries(self, start: datetime, end: datetime) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        if end == start:
+            return []
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        local_start = start.astimezone(exchange_calendar.NEW_YORK).date()
+        local_end = end.astimezone(exchange_calendar.NEW_YORK).date()
+        day = local_start
+        while day <= local_end:
+            try:
+                session = self._calendar.session_for(day)
+            except ValueError:
+                day += timedelta(days=1)
+                continue
+            cutoff = _utc(
+                self._calendar.entry_cutoff(session, self._entry_cutoff_minutes),
+                "entry cutoff",
+            )
+            boundaries = (
+                (TriggerKind.SESSION_OPEN, _utc(session.open_utc, "session open")),
+                (TriggerKind.ENTRY_CUTOFF, cutoff),
+                (TriggerKind.SESSION_CLOSE, _utc(session.close_utc, "session close")),
+            )
+            for kind, instant in boundaries:
+                if start < instant <= end:
+                    due.extend(
+                        self._emit_all_symbols(
+                            kind, instant, discriminator=session.session_id
+                        )
+                    )
+            day += timedelta(days=1)
+        return due
+
+
+# Alternate descriptive name for callers that do not use the Strategy prefix.
+Scheduler = StrategyScheduler
+DueScheduler = StrategyScheduler

+"""Declarative, immutable strategy scheduling triggers.
+
+The declarations in this module contain configuration only.  They deliberately
+have no references to strategies, market-data providers, or execution services.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from enum import StrEnum
+from math import isfinite
+from typing import Final
+
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import ConfigurationError
+from mike_trade.market_data.candles import CandleTimeframe
+
+__all__ = [
+    "TriggerConfigurationError",
+    "TriggerKind",
+    "StrategyTrigger",
+    "Trigger",
+    "MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL",
+    "QUOTE_CHANGE",
+    "SESSION_OPEN",
+    "ENTRY_CUTOFF",
+    "SESSION_CLOSE",
+    "MANUAL",
+    "CANDLE_CLOSED",
+    "INTERVAL",
+]
+
+
+class TriggerConfigurationError(ConfigurationError, ValueError):
+    """Raised when a declarative trigger cannot be loaded safely."""
+
+
+class TriggerKind(StrEnum):
+    """The complete set of scheduler trigger kinds."""
+
+    MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL = "MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL"
+    QUOTE_CHANGE = "QUOTE_CHANGE"
+    CANDLE_CLOSED = "CANDLE_CLOSED"
+    INTERVAL = "INTERVAL"
+    SESSION_OPEN = "SESSION_OPEN"
+    ENTRY_CUTOFF = "ENTRY_CUTOFF"
+    SESSION_CLOSE = "SESSION_CLOSE"
+    MANUAL = "MANUAL"
+
+
+def _error(message: str) -> TriggerConfigurationError:
+    return TriggerConfigurationError(message, code="invalid_strategy_trigger")
+
+
+def _kind(value: object) -> TriggerKind:
+    if isinstance(value, TriggerKind):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return TriggerKind(value.strip().upper())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    raise _error(f"unknown trigger kind {value!r}")
+
+
+def _timeframe(value: object) -> CandleTimeframe:
+    if isinstance(value, CandleTimeframe):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return CandleTimeframe(value.strip().lower())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    supported = ", ".join(frame.value for frame in CandleTimeframe)
+    raise _error(f"unsupported candle timeframe {value!r}; expected one of {supported}")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class StrategyTrigger:
+    """One validated trigger attached to a BUY or SELL strategy declaration.
+
+    ``timeframe`` is present only for :attr:`TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED`, and
+    ``interval_seconds`` only for :attr:`TriggerKind.INTERVAL`.
+    """
+
+    kind: TriggerKind | str
+    timeframe: CandleTimeframe | str | None = None
+    interval_seconds: float | int | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        kind = _kind(self.kind)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "kind", kind)
+
+        if kind is TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED:
+            if self.timeframe is None:
+                raise _error("CANDLE_CLOSED requires a supported timeframe")
+            object.__setattr__(self, "timeframe", _timeframe(self.timeframe))
+        elif self.timeframe is not None:
+            raise _error(f"{kind.value} must not specify a timeframe")
+
+        if kind is TriggerKind.INTERVAL:
+            seconds = self.interval_seconds
+            if (
+                isinstance(seconds, bool)
+                or not isinstance(seconds, int | float)
+                or not isfinite(seconds)
+                or seconds <= 0
+            ):
+                raise _error("INTERVAL requires positive finite interval_seconds")
+            object.__setattr__(self, "interval_seconds", float(seconds))
+        elif self.interval_seconds is not None:
+            raise _error(f"{kind.value} must not specify interval_seconds")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def candle_closed(cls, timeframe: CandleTimeframe | str) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED, timeframe=timeframe)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def interval(cls, seconds: float | int) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.INTERVAL, interval_seconds=seconds)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def market_data_arrival(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def quote_change(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.QUOTE_CHANGE)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def session_open(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.SESSION_OPEN)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def entry_cutoff(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.ENTRY_CUTOFF)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def session_close(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.SESSION_CLOSE)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def manual(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.MANUAL)
+
+
+# A short alias is convenient in strategy class configuration.
+Trigger = StrategyTrigger
+
+# Parameter-free declarations are safe to share because they are frozen values.
+MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL)
+QUOTE_CHANGE: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.QUOTE_CHANGE)
+SESSION_OPEN: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.SESSION_OPEN)
+ENTRY_CUTOFF: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.ENTRY_CUTOFF)
+SESSION_CLOSE: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.SESSION_CLOSE)
+MANUAL: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.MANUAL)
+
+
+def CANDLE_CLOSED(timeframe: CandleTimeframe | str) -> StrategyTrigger:
+    """Build a closed-candle declaration for an h.1-supported timeframe."""
+
+    return StrategyTrigger.candle_closed(timeframe)
+
+
+def INTERVAL(seconds: float | int) -> StrategyTrigger:
+    """Build a positive elapsed-time declaration."""
+
+    return StrategyTrigger.interval(seconds)

+

+)

+class FakeClock:
+    def __init__(self, now: datetime) -> None:
+        self.value = now

+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return self.value
+
+    def advance(self, **kwargs: float) -> None:

+def _utc(value: object, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value.astimezone(UTC)

+def _symbol(value: object) -> str:
+    text = value.strip().upper() if isinstance(value, str) else ""
+    if not text or any(character.isspace() for character in text):
+        raise ValueError("symbol must be a non-empty string without whitespace")
+    return text
+
+
+def _identifier(value: object, field: str) -> str:
+    text = value.strip() if isinstance(value, str) else ""
+    if not text:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return text
+
+
+def _side(value: object) -> StrategyRole:
+    if isinstance(value, StrategyRole):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return StrategyRole(value.strip().upper())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    raise ValueError("side must be StrategyRole.BUY or StrategyRole.SELL")
+
+
+def _version(value: object) -> int:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int) or value < 1:
+        raise ValueError("snapshot_version must be a positive integer")
+    return value
+
+
+def _timeframe(value: object) -> CandleTimeframe:
+    if isinstance(value, CandleTimeframe):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return CandleTimeframe(value.strip().lower())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    raise ValueError(f"unsupported candle timeframe {value!r}")
+
+
+def _price(value: object, field: str) -> Decimal:
+    if isinstance(value, bool):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be numeric")
+    try:
+        result = Decimal(str(value))
+    except (InvalidOperation, ValueError):
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be numeric") from None
+    if not result.is_finite() or result < 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite and non-negative")
+    return result

+class StrategyScheduler:
+    """One deterministic scheduler shared by every symbol and strategy.

+    The synchronous :meth:`process` API is useful to an engine event loop that
+    already serializes inputs.  :meth:`handle` provides an asyncio-safe entry
+    point using one scheduler-level lock; neither API creates background tasks.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        clock: ClockLike,
+        *,
+        calendar: CalendarLike | None = None,
+        watched_symbols: Iterable[str] = (),
+        entry_cutoff_minutes: int = 30,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not hasattr(clock, "now"):
+            raise TypeError("clock must provide now()")
+        if (
+            isinstance(entry_cutoff_minutes, bool)
+            or not isinstance(entry_cutoff_minutes, int)
+            or entry_cutoff_minutes < 0
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("entry_cutoff_minutes must be a non-negative integer")
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._calendar: CalendarLike = calendar or _DefaultCalendar()
+        self._entry_cutoff_minutes = entry_cutoff_minutes
+        self._watched = {_symbol(symbol) for symbol in watched_symbols}
+        self._registry: dict[_RegistryKey, StrategySchedule] = {}
+        self._registered_at: dict[_RegistryKey, datetime] = {}
+        self._next_interval: dict[tuple[_RegistryKey, StrategyTrigger], datetime] = {}
+        self._latest_snapshot: dict[str, int] = {}
+        self._quotes: dict[str, tuple[Decimal, Decimal]] = {}
+        self._seen: set[_SeenKey] = set()
+        self._last_control_at = self._now()
+        self._manual_sequence = 0
+        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()
+
+    def _now(self) -> datetime:
+        return _utc(self._clock.now(), "clock.now()")
+
+    @property
+    def watched_symbols(self) -> frozenset[str]:
+        return frozenset(self._watched)
+
+    @property
+    def registrations(self) -> tuple[StrategySchedule, ...]:
+        return tuple(sorted(self._registry.values(), key=self._registration_sort_key))
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _registration_sort_key(item: StrategySchedule) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
+        return item.symbol, item.strategy_id, item.side.value
+
+    def watch(self, symbol: str) -> None:
+        self._watched.add(_symbol(symbol))
+
+    watch_symbol = watch
+
+    def unwatch(self, symbol: str) -> None:
+        self._watched.discard(_symbol(symbol))
+
+    unwatch_symbol = unwatch
+
+    def register(
+        self,
+        schedule: StrategySchedule | None = None,
+        *,
+        symbol: str | None = None,
+        strategy_id: str | None = None,
+        side: StrategyRole | str | None = None,
+        triggers: Iterable[StrategyTrigger] | None = None,
+        enabled: bool = True,
+        paused: bool = False,
+    ) -> StrategySchedule:
+        if schedule is None:
+            if symbol is None or strategy_id is None or side is None or triggers is None:
+                raise TypeError("register requires a schedule or symbol/strategy_id/side/triggers")
+            schedule = StrategySchedule(
+                symbol=symbol,
+                strategy_id=strategy_id,
+                side=_side(side),
+                triggers=triggers,
+                enabled=enabled,
+                paused=paused,
+            )
+        elif any(value is not None for value in (symbol, strategy_id, side, triggers)):
+            raise TypeError("schedule cannot be combined with registration fields")
+        elif not isinstance(schedule, StrategySchedule):
+            raise TypeError("schedule must be StrategySchedule")
+
+        key = (schedule.symbol, schedule.strategy_id, schedule.side)
+        now = self._now()
+        self._registry[key] = schedule
+        self._registered_at[key] = now
+        for interval_key in tuple(self._next_interval):
+            if interval_key[0] == key:
+                del self._next_interval[interval_key]
+        for trigger in schedule.triggers:
+            if trigger.kind is TriggerKind.INTERVAL:
+                self._next_interval[(key, trigger)] = now + timedelta(
+                    seconds=trigger.interval_seconds  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                )
+        return schedule
+
+    register_strategy = register
+
+    def unregister(self, symbol: str, strategy_id: str, side: StrategyRole | str) -> None:
+        key = (_symbol(symbol), _identifier(strategy_id, "strategy_id"), _side(side))
+        self._registry.pop(key, None)
+        self._registered_at.pop(key, None)
+        for interval_key in tuple(self._next_interval):
+            if interval_key[0] == key:
+                del self._next_interval[interval_key]
+
+    def set_state(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        strategy_id: str,
+        side: StrategyRole | str,
+        *,
+        enabled: bool | None = None,
+        paused: bool | None = None,
+    ) -> StrategySchedule:
+        key = (_symbol(symbol), _identifier(strategy_id, "strategy_id"), _side(side))
+        current = self._registry[key]
+        if enabled is not None and not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+            raise ValueError("enabled must be bool")
+        if paused is not None and not isinstance(paused, bool):
+            raise ValueError("paused must be bool")
+        updated = replace(
+            current,
+            enabled=current.enabled if enabled is None else enabled,
+            paused=current.paused if paused is None else paused,
+        )
+        self._registry[key] = updated
+        return updated
+
+    def process(self, event: SchedulingEvent) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        """Process one input and return a deterministically ordered due list."""
+
+        return self.process_many((event,))
+
+    def on_market_data_arrival(
+        self, symbol: str, snapshot_version: int, due_at: datetime | None = None
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(MarketDataArrivalEvent(symbol, snapshot_version, due_at))
+
+    def on_quote_change(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        bid: Decimal | int | float | str,
+        ask: Decimal | int | float | str,
+        snapshot_version: int,
+        due_at: datetime | None = None,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(QuoteChangeEvent(symbol, bid, ask, snapshot_version, due_at))
+
+    def on_candle_closed(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        timeframe: CandleTimeframe | str,
+        bar_end_utc: datetime,
+        snapshot_version: int | None = None,
+        due_at: datetime | None = None,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(
+            CandleClosedEvent(
+                symbol, timeframe, bar_end_utc, snapshot_version, due_at
+            )
+        )
+
+    def on_session_event(
+        self,
+        kind: TriggerKind | str,
+        session_id: str,
+        due_at: datetime,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(SessionEvent(kind, session_id, due_at))
+
+    def on_control_tick(self) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(ControlTick())
+
+    def request_manual(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        strategy_id: str,
+        side: StrategyRole | str,
+        *,
+        request_id: str | None = None,
+        due_at: datetime | None = None,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        return self.process(
+            ManualEvaluationRequest(symbol, strategy_id, side, request_id, due_at)
+        )
+
+    def process_many(self, events: Iterable[SchedulingEvent]) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        """Process inputs in their given order, then order all resulting records."""
+
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        for event in events:
+            due.extend(self._process_one(event))
+        due.sort(key=self.sort_key)
+        return due
+
+    async def handle(self, event: SchedulingEvent) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        """Asyncio-safe event entry point using one component-wide lock."""
+
+        async with self._lock:
+            return self.process(event)
+
+    async def handle_many(self, events: Iterable[SchedulingEvent]) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        async with self._lock:
+            return self.process_many(events)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def sort_key(item: DueEvaluation) -> tuple[datetime, int, str, str, str]:
+        return (
+            item.due_at,
+            _PRIORITY[item.trigger_kind],
+            item.symbol,
+            item.strategy_id,
+            item.side.value,
+        )
+
+    def _process_one(self, event: SchedulingEvent) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        if isinstance(event, MarketDataArrivalEvent):
+            self._latest_snapshot[event.symbol] = event.snapshot_version
+            return self._emit_for_kind(
+                event.symbol,
+                TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL,
+                event.due_at or self._now(),
+                snapshot_version=event.snapshot_version,
+                discriminator=event.snapshot_version,
+            )
+        if isinstance(event, QuoteChangeEvent):
+            self._latest_snapshot[event.symbol] = event.snapshot_version
+            quote = (cast(Decimal, event.bid), cast(Decimal, event.ask))
+            previous = self._quotes.get(event.symbol)
+            self._quotes[event.symbol] = quote
+            if quote == previous:
+                return []
+            return self._emit_for_kind(
+                event.symbol,
+                TriggerKind.QUOTE_CHANGE,
+                event.due_at or self._now(),
+                snapshot_version=event.snapshot_version,
+                discriminator=event.snapshot_version,
+            )
+        if isinstance(event, CandleClosedEvent):
+            if event.snapshot_version is not None:
+                self._latest_snapshot[event.symbol] = event.snapshot_version
+            bar_key = BarKey(event.symbol, event.timeframe, event.bar_end_utc)
+            return self._emit_for_kind(
+                event.symbol,
+                TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED,
+                event.due_at or event.bar_end_utc,
+                snapshot_version=event.snapshot_version
+                if event.snapshot_version is not None
+                else self._latest_snapshot.get(event.symbol),
+                bar_key=bar_key,
+                discriminator=bar_key,
+                timeframe=cast(CandleTimeframe, event.timeframe),
+            )
+        if isinstance(event, SessionEvent):
+            return self._emit_all_symbols(
+                cast(TriggerKind, event.kind),
+                event.due_at,
+                discriminator=event.session_id,
+            )
+        if isinstance(event, ControlTick):
+            return self._control_tick()
+        if isinstance(event, ManualEvaluationRequest):
+            return self._manual(event)
+        raise TypeError(f"unsupported scheduling event {type(event).__name__}")
+
+    def _eligible(self, schedule: StrategySchedule) -> bool:
+        return (
+            schedule.symbol in self._watched and schedule.enabled and not schedule.paused
+        )
+
+    def _emit_for_kind(
+        self,
+        symbol: str,
+        kind: TriggerKind,
+        due_at: datetime,
+        *,
+        discriminator: object,
+        snapshot_version: int | None = None,
+        bar_key: BarKey | None = None,
+        timeframe: CandleTimeframe | None = None,
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        for key, schedule in sorted(
+            self._registry.items(), key=lambda item: self._registration_sort_key(item[1])
+        ):
+            if schedule.symbol != symbol or not self._eligible(schedule):
+                continue
+            matching = [trigger for trigger in schedule.triggers if trigger.kind is kind]
+            if timeframe is not None:
+                matching = [trigger for trigger in matching if trigger.timeframe is timeframe]
+            if not matching:
+                continue
+            seen_key = (key, kind, discriminator)
+            if seen_key in self._seen:
+                continue
+            self._seen.add(seen_key)
+            due.append(
+                DueEvaluation(
+                    symbol=schedule.symbol,
+                    strategy_id=schedule.strategy_id,
+                    side=schedule.side,
+                    trigger_kind=kind,
+                    snapshot_version=snapshot_version,
+                    bar_key=bar_key,
+                    due_at=due_at,
+                )
+            )
+        return due
+
+    def _emit_all_symbols(
+        self, kind: TriggerKind, due_at: datetime, *, discriminator: object
+    ) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        for symbol in sorted(self._watched):
+            due.extend(
+                self._emit_for_kind(
+                    symbol,
+                    kind,
+                    due_at,
+                    discriminator=discriminator,
+                    snapshot_version=self._latest_snapshot.get(symbol),
+                )
+            )
+        return due
+
+    def _manual(self, event: ManualEvaluationRequest) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        key = (event.symbol, event.strategy_id, cast(StrategyRole, event.side))
+        schedule = self._registry.get(key)
+        if (
+            schedule is None
+            or not self._eligible(schedule)
+            or all(trigger.kind is not TriggerKind.MANUAL for trigger in schedule.triggers)
+        ):
+            return []
+        self._manual_sequence += 1
+        discriminator: object = event.request_id or self._manual_sequence
+        seen_key = (key, TriggerKind.MANUAL, discriminator)
+        if seen_key in self._seen:
+            return []
+        self._seen.add(seen_key)
+        return [
+            DueEvaluation(
+                symbol=schedule.symbol,
+                strategy_id=schedule.strategy_id,
+                side=schedule.side,
+                trigger_kind=TriggerKind.MANUAL,
+                snapshot_version=self._latest_snapshot.get(schedule.symbol),
+                bar_key=None,
+                due_at=event.due_at or self._now(),
+            )
+        ]
+
+    def _control_tick(self) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        now = self._now()
+        if now < self._last_control_at:
+            raise ValueError("clock moved backwards")
+        due = self._session_boundaries(self._last_control_at, now)
+        due.extend(self._intervals(now))
+        self._last_control_at = now
+        return due
+
+    def _intervals(self, now: datetime) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        for (key, trigger), next_due in sorted(
+            self._next_interval.items(),
+            key=lambda item: (
+                item[1],
+                item[0][0][0],
+                item[0][0][1],
+                item[0][0][2].value,
+                item[0][1].interval_seconds or 0,
+            ),
+        ):
+            schedule = self._registry.get(key)
+            if schedule is None or now < next_due:
+                continue
+            seconds = trigger.interval_seconds
+            assert seconds is not None
+            interval = timedelta(seconds=seconds)
+            elapsed = (now - next_due) // interval
+            self._next_interval[(key, trigger)] = next_due + interval * (elapsed + 1)
+            if not self._eligible(schedule):
+                continue
+            discriminator = next_due
+            seen_key = (key, TriggerKind.INTERVAL, discriminator)
+            if seen_key in self._seen:
+                continue
+            self._seen.add(seen_key)
+            due.append(
+                DueEvaluation(
+                    symbol=schedule.symbol,
+                    strategy_id=schedule.strategy_id,
+                    side=schedule.side,
+                    trigger_kind=TriggerKind.INTERVAL,
+                    snapshot_version=self._latest_snapshot.get(schedule.symbol),
+                    bar_key=None,
+                    due_at=next_due,
+                )
+            )
+        return due
+
+    def _session_boundaries(self, start: datetime, end: datetime) -> list[DueEvaluation]:
+        if end == start:
+            return []
+        due: list[DueEvaluation] = []
+        local_start = start.astimezone(exchange_calendar.NEW_YORK).date()
+        local_end = end.astimezone(exchange_calendar.NEW_YORK).date()
+        day = local_start
+        while day <= local_end:
+            try:
+                session = self._calendar.session_for(day)
+            except ValueError:
+                day += timedelta(days=1)
+                continue
+            cutoff = _utc(
+                self._calendar.entry_cutoff(session, self._entry_cutoff_minutes),
+                "entry cutoff",
+            )
+            boundaries = (
+                (TriggerKind.SESSION_OPEN, _utc(session.open_utc, "session open")),
+                (TriggerKind.ENTRY_CUTOFF, cutoff),
+                (TriggerKind.SESSION_CLOSE, _utc(session.close_utc, "session close")),
+            )
+            for kind, instant in boundaries:
+                if start < instant <= end:
+                    due.extend(
+                        self._emit_all_symbols(
+                            kind, instant, discriminator=session.session_id
+                        )
+                    )
+            day += timedelta(days=1)
+        return due
+
+
+# Alternate descriptive name for callers that do not use the Strategy prefix.
+Scheduler = StrategyScheduler
+DueScheduler = StrategyScheduler

+"""Declarative, immutable strategy scheduling triggers.
+
+The declarations in this module contain configuration only.  They deliberately
+have no references to strategies, market-data providers, or execution services.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from enum import StrEnum
+from math import isfinite
+from typing import Final
+
+from mike_trade.domain.errors import ConfigurationError
+from mike_trade.market_data.candles import CandleTimeframe
+
+__all__ = [
+    "TriggerConfigurationError",
+    "TriggerKind",
+    "StrategyTrigger",
+    "Trigger",
+    "MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL",
+    "QUOTE_CHANGE",
+    "SESSION_OPEN",
+    "ENTRY_CUTOFF",
+    "SESSION_CLOSE",
+    "MANUAL",
+    "CANDLE_CLOSED",
+    "INTERVAL",
+]
+
+
+class TriggerConfigurationError(ConfigurationError, ValueError):
+    """Raised when a declarative trigger cannot be loaded safely."""
+
+
+class TriggerKind(StrEnum):
+    """The complete set of scheduler trigger kinds."""
+
+    MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL = "MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL"
+    QUOTE_CHANGE = "QUOTE_CHANGE"
+    CANDLE_CLOSED = "CANDLE_CLOSED"
+    INTERVAL = "INTERVAL"
+    SESSION_OPEN = "SESSION_OPEN"
+    ENTRY_CUTOFF = "ENTRY_CUTOFF"
+    SESSION_CLOSE = "SESSION_CLOSE"
+    MANUAL = "MANUAL"
+
+
+def _error(message: str) -> TriggerConfigurationError:
+    return TriggerConfigurationError(message, code="invalid_strategy_trigger")
+
+
+def _kind(value: object) -> TriggerKind:
+    if isinstance(value, TriggerKind):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return TriggerKind(value.strip().upper())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    raise _error(f"unknown trigger kind {value!r}")
+
+
+def _timeframe(value: object) -> CandleTimeframe:
+    if isinstance(value, CandleTimeframe):
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        try:
+            return CandleTimeframe(value.strip().lower())
+        except ValueError:
+            pass
+    supported = ", ".join(frame.value for frame in CandleTimeframe)
+    raise _error(f"unsupported candle timeframe {value!r}; expected one of {supported}")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class StrategyTrigger:
+    """One validated trigger attached to a BUY or SELL strategy declaration.
+
+    ``timeframe`` is present only for :attr:`TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED`, and
+    ``interval_seconds`` only for :attr:`TriggerKind.INTERVAL`.
+    """
+
+    kind: TriggerKind | str
+    timeframe: CandleTimeframe | str | None = None
+    interval_seconds: float | int | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        kind = _kind(self.kind)
+        object.__setattr__(self, "kind", kind)
+
+        if kind is TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED:
+            if self.timeframe is None:
+                raise _error("CANDLE_CLOSED requires a supported timeframe")
+            object.__setattr__(self, "timeframe", _timeframe(self.timeframe))
+        elif self.timeframe is not None:
+            raise _error(f"{kind.value} must not specify a timeframe")
+
+        if kind is TriggerKind.INTERVAL:
+            seconds = self.interval_seconds
+            if (
+                isinstance(seconds, bool)
+                or not isinstance(seconds, int | float)
+                or not isfinite(seconds)
+                or seconds <= 0
+            ):
+                raise _error("INTERVAL requires positive finite interval_seconds")
+            object.__setattr__(self, "interval_seconds", float(seconds))
+        elif self.interval_seconds is not None:
+            raise _error(f"{kind.value} must not specify interval_seconds")
+
+    @classmethod
+    def candle_closed(cls, timeframe: CandleTimeframe | str) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.CANDLE_CLOSED, timeframe=timeframe)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def interval(cls, seconds: float | int) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.INTERVAL, interval_seconds=seconds)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def market_data_arrival(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def quote_change(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.QUOTE_CHANGE)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def session_open(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.SESSION_OPEN)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def entry_cutoff(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.ENTRY_CUTOFF)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def session_close(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.SESSION_CLOSE)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def manual(cls) -> StrategyTrigger:
+        return cls(TriggerKind.MANUAL)
+
+
+# A short alias is convenient in strategy class configuration.
+Trigger = StrategyTrigger
+
+# Parameter-free declarations are safe to share because they are frozen values.
+MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL)
+QUOTE_CHANGE: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.QUOTE_CHANGE)
+SESSION_OPEN: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.SESSION_OPEN)
+ENTRY_CUTOFF: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.ENTRY_CUTOFF)
+SESSION_CLOSE: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.SESSION_CLOSE)
+MANUAL: Final = StrategyTrigger(TriggerKind.MANUAL)
+
+
+def CANDLE_CLOSED(timeframe: CandleTimeframe | str) -> StrategyTrigger:
+    """Build a closed-candle declaration for an h.1-supported timeframe."""
+
+    return StrategyTrigger.candle_closed(timeframe)
+
+
+def INTERVAL(seconds: float | int) -> StrategyTrigger:
+    """Build a positive elapsed-time declaration."""
+
+    return StrategyTrigger.interval(seconds)

+"""Unit tests for declarative triggers and the engine-owned due scheduler."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio

+import threading
+from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
+from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.domain.strategy_types import StrategyRole
+from mike_trade.market_data.candles import CandleTimeframe
+from mike_trade.scheduling import calendar as nyse
+from mike_trade.scheduling.calendar import Session
+from mike_trade.scheduling.scheduler import (
+    CandleClosedEvent,
+    ControlTick,
+    DueEvaluation,
+    ManualEvaluationRequest,
+    MarketDataArrivalEvent,
+    QuoteChangeEvent,
+    SessionEvent,
+    StrategyScheduler,
+)
+from mike_trade.scheduling.triggers import (
+    CANDLE_CLOSED,
+    ENTRY_CUTOFF,
+    INTERVAL,
+    MANUAL,
+    MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL,
+    QUOTE_CHANGE,
+    SESSION_CLOSE,
+    SESSION_OPEN,
+    StrategyTrigger,
+    TriggerConfigurationError,
+    TriggerKind,
+)
+
+
+class FakeClock:
+    def __init__(self, now: datetime) -> None:
+        self.value = now
+
+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return self.value
+
+    def advance(self, **kwargs: float) -> None:
+        self.value += timedelta(**kwargs)
+
+
+def register(
+    scheduler: StrategyScheduler,
+    strategy_id: str,
+    *triggers: StrategyTrigger,
+    symbol: str = "AAPL",
+    side: StrategyRole = StrategyRole.BUY,
+    enabled: bool = True,
+    paused: bool = False,
+) -> None:
+    scheduler.register(
+        symbol=symbol,
+        strategy_id=strategy_id,
+        side=side,
+        triggers=triggers,
+        enabled=enabled,
+        paused=paused,
+    )
+
+
+def test_all_trigger_declarations_are_frozen_and_validated() -> None:
+    declarations = (
+        MARKET_DATA_ARRIVAL,
+        QUOTE_CHANGE,
+        CANDLE_CLOSED("1m"),
+        CANDLE_CLOSED("5m"),
+        CANDLE_CLOSED("15m"),
+        CANDLE_CLOSED("30m"),
+        CANDLE_CLOSED("60m"),
+        INTERVAL(30),
+        SESSION_OPEN,
+        ENTRY_CUTOFF,
+        SESSION_CLOSE,
+        MANUAL,
+    )
+    assert {item.kind for item in declarations} == set(TriggerKind)
+    for declaration in declarations:
+        with pytest.raises(FrozenInstanceError):
+            declaration.kind = TriggerKind.MANUAL  # type: ignore[misc]
+
+    for seconds in (0, -1):
+        with pytest.raises(TriggerConfigurationError):
+            INTERVAL(seconds)
+    with pytest.raises(TriggerConfigurationError):
+        CANDLE_CLOSED("2m")
+    with pytest.raises(TriggerConfigurationError):
+        StrategyTrigger("PRICE_WIGGLED")
+
+
+def test_closed_candle_fires_once_per_new_bar_and_not_on_control_ticks() -> None:
+    start = datetime(2026, 1, 5, 14, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
+    clock = FakeClock(start)
+    scheduler = StrategyScheduler(clock, watched_symbols=("AAPL",))
+    register(scheduler, "closed-bars", CANDLE_CLOSED(CandleTimeframe.M1))
+
+    first = CandleClosedEvent("AAPL", "1m", start + timedelta(minutes=1), 7)
+    assert len(scheduler.process(first)) == 1
+    assert scheduler.process(first) == []
+    for _ in range(5):
+        clock.advance(seconds=1)
+        assert scheduler.process(ControlTick()) == []
